Voting deserts and 2026 precincts

Harris, Fort Bend, and Montgomery counties

Harris and Fort Bend counties redrew voting precincts for 2026. This site maps each January Advisors voting desert against the 2026 precinct lines and lists the precincts that now fall inside it. Click a desert on the map or in the table to see its precincts.

The desert boundaries have not changed. Only the precinct numbers used to describe them have. A core precinct has at least half of its adults inside the desert. A partial precinct has 10% to 49%. Details are on the Methods page.
